packages.title: SSH access (self-contained)
packages.summary: Self-contained SSH access to your own car: a dry-run checks everything first, then it opens the car's own SSH port to Tailscale only and merges your key into authorized_keys (never removing a key). No new SSH server. Reverts on remove or Off.

manifest.title: SSH access (self-contained)
manifest.summary: Self-contained SSH access to your own car: a dry-run checks everything first, then it opens the car's own SSH port to Tailscale only and merges your key into authorized_keys (never removing a key). No new SSH server. Reverts on remove or Off.

settings.title: Mode
settings.summary: off: inert, nothing changed. check: read-only dry run, writes a report, changes nothing. armed: open the port and merge your keys.

confirm.title: Open SSH on this car?
confirm.text: This opens the car's SSH port to the Tailscale network and adds your key to authorized_keys (existing keys are kept). Run Check first. Only arm this on your own car.

settings.title: SSH port
settings.summary: The port the car's own SSH server listens on (13401 on the cars seen so far).

settings.title: authorized_keys path
settings.summary: Leave empty to auto-detect from the car's sshd_config (AuthorizedKeysFile). Set a path only to override.

settings.title: Authorized keys
settings.summary: One public key per line. Leave empty to use the keys bundled with the package. Only keys not already on the car are added.

packages.title: SSH over Tailscale
packages.summary: Opens the car's own SSH port to the Tailscale network only (one firewall rule on the Tailscale interface). No new SSH server, no keys: logging in still needs a key the car's SSH accepts. Removed with the package.

manifest.title: SSH over Tailscale
manifest.summary: Opens the car's own SSH port to the Tailscale network only (one firewall rule on the Tailscale interface). No new SSH server, no keys: logging in still needs a key the car's SSH accepts. Removed with the package.

settings.title: SSH port
settings.summary: The port the car's SSH server listens on (13401 on the cars seen so far).

packages.title: Tailscale
packages.summary: Puts the car on your tailnet under its VIN. Does nothing when Tailscale already runs on the car. Log in by scanning a QR code on the package's settings page; it shows the car's Tailscale address once it is connected.

manifest.title: Tailscale
manifest.summary: Puts the car on your tailnet under its VIN. Does nothing when Tailscale already runs on the car. Log in by scanning a QR code on the package's settings page; it shows the car's Tailscale address once it is connected.

packages.title: VNC when parked
packages.summary: A VNC server for the car's screen, reachable only over Tailscale and running only while the car is in Park.

manifest.title: VNC when parked
manifest.summary: A VNC server for the car's screen, reachable only over Tailscale and running only while the car is in Park.

settings.title: VNC password
settings.summary: The VNC password. Default is 'coilshift' so it starts on its own; set your own here. Reachable only over Tailscale.

settings.title: View only
settings.summary: Show the screen without taking taps from the VNC client.

settings.title: Port
settings.summary: TCP port on the car's Tailscale address.

packages.title: Web shell
packages.summary: A root bash in the browser (ttyd), reachable only on the car's Tailscale address and only with a password (a random one is made and shown in the panel unless you set one).

manifest.title: Web shell
manifest.summary: A root bash in the browser (ttyd), reachable only on the car's Tailscale address and only with a password (a random one is made and shown in the panel unless you set one).

settings.title: Password
settings.summary: At least 8 characters, user name root. Empty: a random password is made once and shown in the Web shell panel.

settings.title: Port
settings.summary: TCP port on the car's Tailscale address.
